name: Panatta 3D Abductor
instructions: Adjust the machine so your working hip lines up with the movement arm and your torso is braced against the pad.
Set the starting angle to a comfortable stretch and hold the handles for stability.
Drive the working leg out and slightly back through the guided path without rotating your torso.
Pause briefly at the end range, then return under control before repeating on the other side.

name: Panatta Back Deltoids
instructions: Set the seat and chest pad so the handles start in front of your shoulders.
Keep your chest against the pad and hold the handles with a neutral grip.
Pull your arms out and back until your elbows are roughly in line with your torso.
Control the handles back to the start without letting the weight stack drop.

name: Panatta Gluteus Machine
instructions: Adjust the footrest and starting angle so your working hip can move through a full range without your lower back arching.
Brace your torso against the pad and place the working foot firmly on the platform.
Drive the platform back by extending your hip and squeezing your glute.
Return slowly to the starting position and complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Panatta Hip Thrust
instructions: Set the pad across your hips and plant your feet so your shins are near vertical at the top of the lift.
Brace your torso against the bench and unlock the carriage or lever.
Drive through your heels to extend your hips until your torso and thighs form a straight line.
Lower under control until you feel a stretch in the glutes, then repeat.

name: Panatta Lateral Deltoids
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders align with the machine's pivot point.
Place your upper arms against the pads and keep your torso upright.
Raise your elbows out to the sides until your upper arms are near shoulder height.
Lower with control and keep tension on the deltoids between repetitions.

name: Panatta Leg Curling
instructions: Adjust the pad so it rests just above your heels and align your knees with the machine's pivot point.
Brace your torso against the pad and hold the handles.
Curl your lower legs toward your hamstrings as far as the machine allows.
Squeeze briefly, then return slowly until your knees are extended without locking out harshly.

name: Panatta Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the back pad and ankle roller so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Sit tall with your hips anchored and hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are nearly straight, keeping the movement smooth.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the weight under control.

name: Panatta Super Declined Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start slightly below chest level.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled back against the pad and grip the handles evenly.
Press the handles forward and slightly downward until your arms are nearly extended.
Lower under control until you feel a chest stretch, then repeat.

name: Panatta Super Deltoid Press
instructions: Adjust the seat and back pad so the handles begin around shoulder height.
Brace your back against the pad and choose a grip that keeps your wrists neutral.
Press the handles upward through the guided path without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower slowly to the starting position and keep your elbows under control.

name: Panatta Super Hack Squat
instructions: Set your shoulders and back firmly against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Unlock the safety handles and keep your knees tracking in line with your toes.
Lower by bending your knees and hips until you reach a controlled depth.
Drive through the platform to return to standing, stopping short of a hard knee lockout.

name: Panatta Super High Row
instructions: Adjust the seat, knee pads, and chest support so you can reach the handles with your arms extended.
Brace your chest against the pad and choose a neutral, semi-pronated, or semi-supinated grip.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your sides while keeping your torso fixed.
Control the handles back to a full stretch before starting the next rep.

name: Panatta Super Horizontal Bench Press
instructions: Adjust the start position so the handles sit near mid-chest with your shoulder blades set against the pad.
Grip the handles evenly and keep your feet planted.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight without losing your chest position.
Lower under control until the handles return to the starting point.

name: Panatta Super Horizontal Multi Press
instructions: Select the press bar and start height that match your target grip and range of motion.
Lie back with your shoulder blades retracted and your feet braced.
Press the handles through the guided arc until your arms are nearly extended.
Lower with control to a comfortable chest stretch before repeating.

name: Panatta Super Inclined Bench Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Keep your back against the pad and grip the handles with your wrists stacked over your elbows.
Press upward and forward through the machine's path until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a controlled stretch across the upper chest.

name: Panatta Super Inclined Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles begin just outside the upper chest.
Brace your torso against the pad and keep your shoulder blades down.
Press the independent handles up and in through the guided path.
Return slowly to the start while keeping tension on the chest.

name: Panatta Super Lat Machine Convergent
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad so your body is locked down while your arms can reach overhead.
Grip the handles and start with your shoulders elevated but your torso upright.
Pull your elbows down toward your sides until the handles reach upper-chest level.
Let the handles rise under control until your lats are stretched.

name: Panatta Super Leg Press 45 Degree
instructions: Set the backrest and safeties, then place your feet on the platform at a comfortable width.
Unlock the carriage and keep your hips and back against the pad.
Lower the platform until your knees bend deeply without your pelvis lifting.
Press the platform away by driving through your full foot and stop short of locking your knees.

name: Panatta Super Low Row
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so your arms can reach forward without rounding your back.
Brace against the pad and hold the handles with your chosen grip.
Pull your elbows back until your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Return the handles forward under control and allow a full stretch before repeating.

name: Panatta Super Middle Chest Flight Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and arm pads so your elbows begin slightly behind your torso at chest height.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows and press your back into the pad.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest by squeezing your pecs.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a controlled chest stretch.

name: Panatta Super Pendulum Squat
instructions: Set the shoulder pads and foot platform so you can squat without your heels lifting.
Brace your torso, unlock the lever, and keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend through the guided arc until you reach your planned depth.
Drive the platform away to stand back up while maintaining control of the carriage.

name: Panatta Super Pullover Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and back pad so the handle starts overhead with your torso secured.
Grip the handle or pads and keep your ribs down as you begin from a stretched position.
Pull the handle down and forward by driving your upper arms toward your torso.
Return slowly overhead without letting your shoulders lose position.

name: Panatta Super Rowing
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest support so your arms can reach the handles with a full stretch.
Brace your torso and select the grip that best matches your target line of pull.
Row the handles back by driving your elbows behind your body.
Pause briefly, then return to the start under control.

name: Panatta Super Shrug Machine
instructions: Set the handle height so your arms hang straight with your shoulders depressed at the start.
Stand tall on the platform and hold the handles without bending your elbows.
Elevate your shoulder blades upward and slightly inward through the machine's path.
Lower under control until your traps are fully stretched.

name: Panatta Super Upper Chest Flight Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the upper chest.
Keep your back against the pad and maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles up and together by squeezing through the upper chest.
Open back to the starting position slowly and stop before your shoulders roll forward.

name: Panatta Super Vertical Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest height.
Keep your feet planted, chest tall, and shoulder blades set against the pad.
Press the handles forward through the guided path until your arms are nearly extended.
Lower back to the start with control and keep your elbows tracking naturally.

name: Panatta Three Angles Biceps Machine
instructions: Set the seat and arm pad so your upper arms are supported and your elbows align with the machine.
Choose the handle angle that keeps your wrists comfortable.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders without lifting your upper arms from the pad.
Lower slowly until your elbows are extended and repeat.

name: Panatta Three Angles Triceps Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and arm pad so your upper arms stay supported throughout the movement.
Choose the handle angle that keeps your wrists neutral and your elbows comfortable.
Extend your elbows until your arms are nearly straight while keeping your torso still.
Return under control until the triceps are stretched, then repeat.

name: Single-Leg Kneeling Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the machine so the roller pad sits just above the ankle of your working leg when that leg is straight. Kneel on the knee pad with the other leg, rest your chest and hips against the support pad and hold the handles. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your hips square and your torso still, curl your heel toward your glutes as far as possible by flexing at the knee. Hold the contracted position for a second.
Lower the leg back to the starting position under control as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions, then perform the same exercise with the other leg.
